about.title: About Dr. Bipin Nepal
about.text: Dr. Bipin Nepal is a Nepali physician specializing in Transfusion Medicine and Tissue Typing. His work connects specialist clinical practice with blood-bank management, immunohematology, transfusion safety, blood-component therapy, research, and professional education. He has held leadership roles at Grande International Hospital in Kathmandu, Birat Medical College in Biratnagar, and TU Lions Blood Transfusion and Research Centre in Kathmandu. His approach places patient safety, evidence-based practice, dependable quality systems, and practical service development at the centre of transfusion care. He serves as Joint Secretary of the Asian Association of Transfusion Medicine and participates in the Education Working Group of the AABB Global Transfusion Forum.
